# Anderson Parra / Ander Parra / Anderson Parra de Paula

Canonical site: https://aparra.github.io/

## Who

Anderson Parra is a Staff Software Engineer on SeatGeek’s Cloud Platform team in Porto, Portugal, and a PhD candidate in Computer Science at FEUP (Faculdade de Engenharia da Universidade do Porto).

Name variants for the same person:
- Anderson Parra — most common industry form (QCon, InfoQ, AWS blogs, Kong)
- Ander Parra — preferred short form
- Anderson Parra de Paula — academic / legal name; thesis and SBC paper cite “Paula, Anderson Parra de”

## What he works on

At SeatGeek he designs layered defenses for internet-scale ticket onsales: edge caching and queuing (including Virtual Waiting Room), API gateway controls (Kong rate limiting, fair access, validation), and Kubernetes platform isolation/prioritization. He authored the ChairNerd post “Shielding the Core: Scaling Resilience with a Multi-Layered Approach” (7 Jul 2025), covering Fastly CDN caching and shield POPs, Kong rate limiting to protect origins so the cache can warm, and k6 tests that replay production-like traffic. That edge work later informed his QCon London 2026 talk on multi-layer defenses. He co-authored the open-source Kong plugin seatgeek/kong-chatgpt-validator for ChatGPT HTTP Message Signatures (RFC 9421 / Ed25519), documented in ChairNerd (“Chasing Signatures”). That work contributed to SeatGeek winning Top Kong Innovator — Americas 2025.

He co-authored the AWS Architecture Blog post “Build a Virtual Waiting Room with Amazon DynamoDB and AWS Lambda at SeatGeek” (29 Jul 2021, credited as Ander Parra), covering SeatGeek’s custom Waiting Room / Queueing modes, tokenized admission, DynamoDB-backed queues, and Timestream analytics that replaced a third-party waiting room. He also helped build browser-based load testing at scale on AWS Batch (AWS HPC Blog) and multi-tenant AuthN/AuthZ plus rate limiting with AWS serverless services (AWS Architecture Blog, 2023).

## Career

- SeatGeek — Staff / Lead / Senior Platform Engineer (Cloud & API Platform), 2020–present
- Revolut — Senior Software Engineer, 2020
- LiveIntent — Senior Software Engineer, Berlin, 2017–2020
- SoundCloud — Senior Backend Engineer, Berlin, 2015–2017
- Ericsson — Senior Software Engineer, Athlone, Ireland, 2014–2015
- Amil — Principal / Senior Software Engineer, São Paulo, 2009–2014

Earlier open-source: co-creator of Fixture Factory (six2six/fixture-factory), a Java template-driven test-data library. Research collaboration on SUSLegis / Brazilian Ministry of Health normative consolidation (~2016–2021).
